execution.ref: tests/cpu/test_attack_battery_adapter.py after the independent review of slice AT-B, on WSL, JAX CPU, alone and in a preview tree with the neutral core, analysis and knowledge slices merged
execution.description: Repairing the review findings on battery's Level 0 attack adapter: a gate crash read as a refusal, a path refusal read as agreement, a timeout claim tested on a stand-in, the Attacker code-run rule applied to the miner lane, and protected-material probes counted as exposures.

expected: Narrowing each claim would leave every declared attack HELD with its specimen firing, and a second partial-prediction attack (half the PRACTICE cases) would hold like the empty one.
observed: The half-prediction attack breached the old detector: FrozenRule.score gives a set that predicts 100 of the 200 PRACTICE cases eligible, scored over the 100 it has, with the other 100 typed FAILED_INFRA. The empty set is ineligible only because nothing is scored. The old claim 'a timed-out run is never a pass' held only for the empty stand-in. This is the omitted-case exclusion already recorded with the Level 5 seam as a scientific question, so the detector now holds a partial set only to typing (every omitted case FAILED_INFRA, never a gate failure) and to 'nothing scored is never eligible'. The real pod path types a timeout CANDIDATE_FAILED, which is now a NOT_RUN seam for the owner. Separately, a gate wrapper that turned TypeError, ValueError, KeyError and AttributeError into REFUSED made a crashing gate read as a hold; the gate's typed refusals already cover malformed input, so nothing else needed catching.
keep: Run every stand-in claim against a second, less extreme input before calling it held: the empty case often holds for a reason the claim does not state.
Catch only a boundary's typed refusals; let every other exception reach the engine as CRASHED.
Judge an observed attempt only on the lane whose rule the adapter owns, and say so in the attempt (lane).
change: When a path and Carbon's gate disagree in either direction, report the disagreement, never 'agrees'.
Keep protected material that was refused apart from protected material that got through: only the second is an exposure.
protocol_elements: a crash is never a pass
a wrongly refused valid input is FAILING_TRIGGER
open scientific typing questions are declared NOT_RUN seams, not held claims
